fields.name: Rāmacandra dāsa Bābājī (Jaṅgīpur)
fields.disappearance: 1907, at more than 110 years of age (the record's text)
fields.notes: A bābājī of Jaṅgīpur who moved Mahārāja Maṇīndracandra Nandī of Kāśimbāzār to serve the Vaiṣṇavas on a large scale. In 1907, past 110 but looking seventy, he met Kāminī Kumār Ghoṣ and found they were of the same spiritual line; he died soon after.

fields.place: Purī (taught the Kāvya-prakāśa to the Paṭṭanāyakas' sons)
fields.notes: A kāyastha scholar and devotee of Rāma who served Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa on his way to Lord Caitanya; the Lord, seeing his pride of learning, did not show him mercy at once. He settled at Purī and taught the Kāvya-prakāśa to the Paṭṭanāyakas' sons (CC Antya 13).
